# ChoiceScript public sample fixture

These files are copied from the public ChoiceScript sample game in `dfabulich/choicescript`, branch `main`, path `web/mygame/scenes`. They are used by browser import tests to verify real multi-scene ChoiceScript import/export behavior without depending on machine-local scratch paths.

Source listing: https://api.github.com/repos/dfabulich/choicescript/contents/web/mygame/scenes?ref=main

Most files include Dan Fabulich's original ChoiceScript License header. The fixture is kept unchanged except for storing it in this test directory.
